name: The fork rest
description: The last lamp on the hunters' trail, where the Waykeepers' road stops and the old folk's stones take over. A roadside rest with an Even Court waystone at the fork side, a ward thread leaving it toward the dying stand, and a grey stone at the thread's end that nobody explains. Sergeant Torsten keeps the watch here beside the Wayward Watch; two sentinels keep the stone and say one line each.

signs.title: THE FORK REST
lines: the stone keeps the mile past it
